data.Title: Mortal Kombat II
data.Writer: Jeremy Slater, Ed Boon, John Tobias
data.Actors: Karl Urban, Ludi Lin, Jessica McNamee
data.Plot: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.
